name: Spiral Block Wipe
description: Square blocks switch to the second clip one after another along a rectangular spiral, from the border inward or from the center outward. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: inward
params.description: Spiral from the top left corner inward; off spirals from the center outward, ending at the top left corner

params.name: smoothness
params.description: Duration of each block's fade, as a part of the transition
